description: A hand-rolled joint, a little crooked, twisted off at the end. Smells like a greenhouse and bad decisions.

overdose.message: You have smoked far too much. The room tilts, your heart hammers, and a cold wave of paranoid nausea rolls over you. You green out.

phases.comeup_message: You spark it up and draw slow. The room exhales with you; the edges go soft and warm.
phases.end_message: The high tapers off. The colours go back to normal and you are suddenly, urgently thinking about a sandwich.
phases.peak_message: You are extremely stoned. Everything is faintly hilarious and the music is unbelievable.

effects.take_line: You spark the {name} and pull on it.

name: joint
